scope: Bipartite-support structural-rank and Hall-deficiency prefilter for future owner-authenticated K77 degree-changing coefficient blocks.

theorem.structural_rank: maximum bipartite matching size of the coefficient support graph
theorem.hall_use: support rank below the K475 required rank is a coefficient-independent rejection
theorem.ceiling: passing support does not prove actual rank, nilpotence, domain preservation or action custody

claim_ceiling: Exact structural-support prefilter only. Hall deficiency can reject an impossible rank before numerical expansion; a passing support graph does not prove numerical rank, nilpotence, closed-domain preservation, action ownership, properness or physical cohomology.
